tagline: Cloud Redis lookups and command runs for remote teammates — the REST token defines the limits.
requirements: Set UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN in the host environment, from an Upstash database's REST credentials. This is the official server from Upstash; prefer a read-only token for sharing.

tools.name: redis_run_commands
tools.note: Runs arbitrary Redis commands — with a read-write token this can modify or delete data.

seo.description: Share the official Upstash Redis MCP server with MCPWire. Configure REST credentials on the host, let teammates run Redis commands over P2P, and use a read-only token to stay safe.
